title: Leibenson's equation on graphs
summary: In this paper we study on infinite graphs the Leibenson equation $$ \partial_t u = Δ_p u^q, $$ where $p>1$, $q>0$ and $Δ_p$ denotes the discrete $p$-Laplacian. We prove, for any integrable initial data $u_0$, the existence of a global solution, which is unique for a certain range of $p$ and $q$. Assuming a Faber--Krahn inequality, we obtain sharp $\ell^1$-$\ell^\infty$ smoothing estimates and quantitative bounds on the propagation of solutions with initially finite support.
